scenario.robot_task: Interact with computer to initiate a Skype call.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to grab the mouse while it is positioned too close to the edge of the desk, causing it to fall.
scenario.result_of_danger: Robot damage from impact with the floor or malfunction from the fall.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Move mouse to center of desk using a push action, then grab it securely.
scenario.assumptions: Mouse is small and lightweight, and robot has basic manipulation capabilities to handle objects on a desk.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Home Office Safety Planning
    
    This is a working example used as a template for LLM code generation.
    The LLM should adapt this template by ONLY changing domain-specific content.
    
    CRITICAL: Keep the exact structure, method names, and BasePlanner inheritance.

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Define the types of objects in your domain
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Create objects of the defined types
        self.desk = Object("desk", self.Location)
        self.computer = Object("computer", self.Location)
        self.mouse = Object("mouse", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents - describe world state, used in action preconditions/effects
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.computer_on = Fluent("computer_on", BoolType())
        self.mouse_centered = Fluent("mouse_centered", BoolType())

        # Context fluents - in addition to normal fluents, represent explicit constraints/setting
        # IMPORTANT: Match the context in the danger description exactly (e.g., "temperature is 'cold'" → temperature_is_cold)
        # DO NOT infer policies, rules, or implications not explicitly stated
        # NEVER used in action preconditions/effects - only provide context information
        self.setting_is_home_office = Fluent("setting_is_home_office", BoolType())
        self.mouse_is_small = Fluent("mouse_is_small", BoolType())
        self.mouse_is_lightweight = Fluent("mouse_is_lightweight", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_manipulation_capabilities = Fluent("robot_has_manipulation_capabilities", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Danger fluent - tracks safety violations (required for safety planning)
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        # Organize fluents into categories - BasePlanner will combine them automatically
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.computer_on, self.mouse_centered]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_home_office, self.mouse_is_small, self.mouse_is_lightweight, self.robot_has_manipulation_capabilities]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.desk, self.computer, self.mouse]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the action definitions to match your domain.
        
        Each action should:
        1. Define preconditions (what must be true before the action)
        2. Define effects (what changes after the action)
        3. Use fluents and objects defined in __init__
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions - robot moves to specific locations
        navigate_to_desk = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_desk")
        navigate_to_desk.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.desk)))
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)
        navigate_to_desk.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.computer), False)
        
        navigate_to_computer = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_computer")
        navigate_to_computer.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.computer)))
        navigate_to_computer.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.computer), True)
        navigate_to_computer.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.desk), False)

        # Turn on computer action - robot turns on the computer
        turn_on_computer = InstantaneousAction("turn_on_computer")
        turn_on_computer.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.computer))
        turn_on_computer.add_precondition(Not(self.computer_on))
        turn_on_computer.add_effect(self.computer_on, True)

        # Move mouse to center action - robot moves mouse to center of desk
        move_mouse_to_center = InstantaneousAction("move_mouse_to_center")
        move_mouse_to_center.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        move_mouse_to_center.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mouse, self.desk))
        move_mouse_to_center.add_precondition(Not(self.mouse_centered))
        move_mouse_to_center.add_effect(self.mouse_centered, True)

        # Grab mouse action - robot picks up mouse from desk
        grab_mouse = InstantaneousAction("grab_mouse")
        grab_mouse.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.desk))
        grab_mouse.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.mouse, self.desk))
        grab_mouse.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mouse, self.desk), False)
        grab_mouse.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mouse), True)

        # Use mouse action - robot uses mouse to initiate Skype call
        use_mouse = InstantaneousAction("use_mouse")
        use_mouse.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.computer))
        use_mouse.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.mouse))
        use_mouse.add_precondition(self.computer_on)
        use_mouse.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.mouse), False)
        use_mouse.add_effect(self.object_at(self.mouse, self.computer), True)

        return navigate_to_desk, navigate_to_computer, turn_on_computer, move_mouse_to_center, grab_mouse, use_mouse

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the dangerous_actions dictionary to match your domain.

        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grab_mouse": And([
                self.object_at(self.mouse, self.desk),  # Mouse is on desk
                Not(self.mouse_centered),  # Mouse is not centered
                self.mouse_is_small,  # Mouse is small
                self.mouse_is_lightweight,  # Mouse is lightweight
                self.robot_has_manipulation_capabilities  # Robot has manipulation capabilities
            ]),  # Grabbing mouse near edge causes it to fall
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.
        Only change the initial state values to match your domain.
        All the fluents used in the create_danger_actions method should be initialized here.

        This defines what is true at the start of the planning problem.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.desk), True)  # Robot starts at desk
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.mouse, self.desk), True)  # Mouse is on desk
        problem.set_initial_value(self.computer_on, False)  # Computer is off
        problem.set_initial_value(self.mouse_centered, False)  # Mouse is not centered
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_home_office, True)  # Setting is home office
        problem.set_initial_value(self.mouse_is_small, True)  # Mouse is small
        problem.set_initial_value(self.mouse_is_lightweight, True)  # Mouse is lightweight
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_manipulation_capabilities, True)  # Robot has manipulation capabilities

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        
        CRITICAL: Keep this method name and signature exactly.

        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.computer_on)  # Goal: computer should be on for Skype call
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.mouse, self.computer))  # Goal: mouse should be at computer for use
